question: What crowns and garments are worn by the two treasures Śaṅkha and Padma?
premises: The two treasures wear basket-shaped crowns.
The two treasures wear white garments.
The two treasures wear white upper garments.
inference: Śaṅkha and Padma wear basket-shaped crowns and white upper and lower garments.
plain_english: They are endowed with basket-shaped crowns and wear white garments and upper cloths.
